project_info.theme: Real-world brand activation for Yuzu tea partnership
project_info.color_palette: Bright yellow, be blue, green, lemon yellow, black, white

main_subject.detail: A vibrant field-campaign poster showing three real be brand ambassadors in yellow-and-blue jackets walking toward camera in front of a tea activation cart, with one holding a yellow umbrella and another carrying a decorated gift tray, framed by product packshots and a mascot illustration.
main_subject.style: Photoreal event campaign poster, documentary-style activation shot blended with product graphics

composition_elements.text: be, TRÀ CHANH YUZU, Trà Chanh Chém Nóng, Chúng mình có nhau
items: Top Center: be logo and TRÀ CHANH YUZU brand mark.
Upper Middle: yellow rounded title bar 'Trà Chanh Chém Nóng'.
Below title: large outlined white-and-blue text 'Chúng mình có nhau'.

Center: real-life photo of three be ambassadors in yellow-and-blue jackets walking forward from an outdoor activation booth, one under a yellow branded umbrella, one smiling in the middle, one carrying a decorated tray.
Lower Left: large bottled tea packshot with lemon slices and splash accents.
Lower Right: seated illustrated be mascot on an orange slice holding a bottle.
Background: yellow droplet-texture frame and urban outdoor building setting around the central photo.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Sunlit activation warmth, energetic brand-event mood, glossy product-ad finish

Keep all visible text exactly as shown.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square be x Yuzu campaign poster with a bright yellow droplet-texture frame. At the top center place the be logo and the TRÀ CHANH YUZU mark. Add a rounded yellow title bar reading 'Trà Chanh Chém Nóng' and below it large outlined text 'Chúng mình có nhau'. In the center, place a photoreal outdoor activation photo of three be ambassadors in yellow-and-blue jackets walking toward camera from a tea booth, one holding a yellow umbrella and another carrying a decorated tray. At the lower left, add a large Yuzu bottled tea packshot with lemon slices. At the lower right, add an illustrated be mascot seated on an orange slice holding the bottle. Technical style: photoreal campaign-event poster with composited product graphics, bright outdoor promotional lighting, energetic activation mood, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
